user.title: Add an eWeLink bulb
user.description: Enter the bulb's LAN address and the device ID and key read from its pairing access point (GET http://<bulb-pairing-address>/device). Nothing is sent to the cloud.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bulb on port 8081. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant can route to it.
error.invalid_auth: The bulb answered but rejected the device ID or key.
